title: Core package skeleton completeness
objective: Add all missing package directories and __init__.py files for the mechdsl-core architecture (frontend, symbolic, ir, lowering, codegen, solver, verify, lib).

plan_assets.asset_description: Repository directory structure showing expected subpackages

implementation_steps: Create subdirectories: frontend/, symbolic/, symbolic/models/, ir/, lowering/, codegen/, codegen/templates/, solver/, verify/, lib/
deliverables: Complete package directory tree under packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/
acceptance_criteria: Imports for each subpackage (frontend, symbolic, ir, lowering, codegen, solver, verify, lib) succeed
verification_commands: uv run python -c "import mechdsl; import mechdsl.frontend; import mechdsl.symbolic; import mechdsl.ir; import mechdsl.lowering; import mechdsl.codegen; import mechdsl.solver; import mechdsl.verify; import mechdsl.lib"
risks: Missing __init__.py in nested dirs can cause import failures — no plan mitigation provided
